notChecked: Real Touch ID, Keychain, cb-mpc, signature generation/verification, network delivery, chain execution, and secret storage are outside this UI prototype.
VoiceOver, native macOS accessibility, full keyboard navigation, real device recovery, signing/session persistence and crash behavior, and all browser/platform combinations were not tested.

visualReview.method: Each of the 12 final PNG files was opened with view_image; request and dialog screenshots were checked for their intended visible states.
observations: The original seven screenshots explicitly use the light theme; the five added screenshots explicitly use the dark theme.
Light and dark request overview screenshots show the pending-review state; native-confirmation screenshots show an open design dialog; unknown-result screenshots show the unknown state.
No unintended horizontal clipping or overlapping content observed. Long request details and the confirmation dialog scroll vertically.
No real authentication, cryptography, signature, or chain operation is represented by these UI screenshots.

browserInputChecks: Pointer clicks wait until elementFromPoint confirms the intended visible control is hit; confirmation layout assertions require dialog.open and nonzero dimensions.
